fields.title: cc_mw

fields.title: cc_sus

fields.title: chan_at
fields.text: chan_at — Monophonic aftertouch if MPE is disabled. Range: Ranges from 0 to 1. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: clamp_output

fields.title: cycle

fields.title: decay

fields.title: deform

fields.title: delay

fields.title: hold
fields.text: hold — Value of the modulator’s Hold parameter. Range: Ranges from 0 to 1. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: intphase

fields.title: is_voice
fields.text: is_voice — Is set to true when the modulator is a voice modulator. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.range: +1/-1 per octave centered at middle C

fields.title: macros
fields.text: macros — See tutorial Macros And Voice Parameters (#6). (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: output
fields.text: output — Output value of the Formula modulator itself (see also clamp_output). Range: Outputs between -1 and 1 by default. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: pb
fields.text: pb — Current value of pitch bend. Range: Ranges from -1 to 1. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: pb_range_dn
fields.text: pb_range_dn — Pitch bend down range. Range: Set as Bend Depth in the UI. (Parameter of Formula.)
fields.range: Set as Bend Depth in the UI

fields.title: pb_range_up
fields.text: pb_range_up — Pitch bend up range. Range: Set as Bend Depth in the UI. (Parameter of Formula.)
fields.range: Set as Bend Depth in the UI

fields.title: phase
fields.text: phase — Continuous value representing the real-time phase position of the modulator output. Range: Cycles from 0 to 1. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: poly_limit
fields.text: poly_limit — Polyphony limit. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: rate
fields.text: rate — Value of the modulator’s Rate parameter. Range: Ranges from -7 to 9. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: release
fields.text: release — Value of the modulator’s Release parameter. Range: Ranges from 0 to 1. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: released
fields.text: released — Is set to true when the modulator is in the release state. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: retrigger_AEG
fields.text: retrigger_AEG — Can be set to true to trigger the Amplitude EG. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: retrigger_FEG
fields.text: retrigger_FEG — Can be set to true to trigger the Filter EG. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: samplerate
fields.text: samplerate — Host sample rate. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: songpos
fields.text: songpos — Host song position. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: startphase
fields.text: startphase — Value of the modulator’s Phase slider. Range: Ranges from 0 to 1. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: subscriptions
fields.text: subscriptions — See tutorial Macros And Voice Parameters (#6). (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: sustain
fields.text: sustain — Value of the modulator’s Sustain parameter. Range: Ranges from 0 to 1. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: tempo
fields.text: tempo — Host tempo. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: use_envelope
fields.text: use_envelope — Can be set to false to disable the LFO Envelope Generator shaping the modulator output. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: channel
fields.text: channel — MIDI/MPE channel that triggered the modulator. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: key
fields.text: key — Key that triggered the modulator. Range: MIDI note number. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: mpe_bend
fields.text: mpe_bend — Current MPE Pitch bend value. Range: Ranges from -1 to 1. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: mpe_bendrange
fields.text: mpe_bendrange — MPE Pitch bend range. Range: Set in the MPE menu. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: mpe_pressure
fields.text: mpe_pressure — MPE Pressure. Range: Ranges from 0 to 1. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: mpe_timbre
fields.text: mpe_timbre — MPE Timbre. Range: Ranges from 0 to 1. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: poly_at
fields.text: poly_at — Per note polyphonic aftertouch. Range: Ranges from 0 to 1. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: rel_velocity
fields.text: rel_velocity — Per note release velocity value. Range: Ranges from 0 to 127. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: velocity
fields.text: velocity — Per note velocity value. Range: Ranges from 0 to 127. (Parameter of Formula.)

fields.title: Shape
fields.text: Shape — Waveform shape. -100% = pulse, 0% = saw, 100% = dual saw. Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Classic.)

fields.title: Width 1
fields.text: Width 1 — Duty cycle (pulse) or relative phase (dual saw). Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Classic.)

fields.title: Width 2
fields.text: Width 2 — Squeezes or expands the waveform in a different way. If positive, the two latter halves of two consecutive single cycles get squeezed closer together. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Classic.)

fields.title: Sub Mix
fields.text: Sub Mix — Sub-oscillator mix, 0% = only main, 100% = only sub. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Classic.)

fields.title: Sync
fields.text: Sync — Oscillator hard sync. Range: 0 .. 60 semitones. (Parameter of Classic.)

fields.title: Unison Detune
fields.text: Unison Detune — Detuning of unison oscillators. Can be extended. Can be switched between relative (default) and absolute. Range: 0 .. 100 cents 0 .. 1200 cents 0 .. 16 Hz 0 .. 192 Hz. (Parameter of Classic.)

fields.title: Unison Voices
fields.text: Unison Voices — Number of oscillators used for unison (1 = disabled). Range: 1 .. 16. (Parameter of Classic.)

fields.title: Sawtooth
fields.text: Sawtooth — Amplitude of the Sawtooth waveform. Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Modern.)

fields.title: Pulse
fields.text: Pulse — Amplitude of the Pulse waveform. Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Modern.)

fields.title: Triangle/Sine/Square
fields.text: Triangle/Sine/Square — Amplitude of the third waveform, can be right- clicked (for more information, see below this parameter list). Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Modern.)

fields.title: Width
fields.text: Width — Duty cycle of the Pulse waveform. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Modern.)

fields.title: Sync
fields.text: Sync — Oscillator hard sync. Range: 0 .. 60 semitones. (Parameter of Modern.)

fields.title: Unison Detune
fields.text: Unison Detune — Detuning of unison oscillators. Can be extended. Can be switched between relative (default) and absolute. Range: 0 .. 100 cents 0 .. 1200 cents 0 .. 16 Hz 0 .. 192 Hz. (Parameter of Modern.)

fields.title: Unison Voices
fields.text: Unison Voices — Number of oscillators used for unison (1 = unison disabled). Range: 1 .. 16. (Parameter of Modern.)

fields.title: Morph
fields.text: Morph — Interpolates between wavetable frames. 0% = first frame, 100% = last frame. Can be set to non-continuous. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Wavetable.)

fields.title: Skew Vertical
fields.text: Skew Vertical — Vertical skew of the waveform. Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Wavetable.)

fields.title: Saturate
fields.text: Saturate — Soft saturation of the waveform. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Wavetable.)

fields.title: Formanti
fields.text: Formanti — Compresses the waveform in time but keeps the cycle- time intact. Range: 0 .. 60 semitones. (Parameter of Wavetable.)

fields.title: Skew Horizontal
fields.text: Skew Horizontal — Horizontal skew of the waveform. Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Wavetable.)

fields.title: Unison Detune
fields.text: Unison Detune — Detuning of unison oscillators. Can be extended. Can be switched between relative (default) and absolute. Range: 0 .. 100 cents 0 .. 1200 cents 0 .. 16 Hz 0 .. 192 Hz. (Parameter of Wavetable.)

fields.title: Unison Voices
fields.text: Unison Voices — Number of oscillators used for unison. 1 = disabled. Range: 1 .. 16. (Parameter of Wavetable.)

fields.title: Morph
fields.text: Morph — Selects a frame from the wavetable, without interpolation. 0% = first frame, 100% = last frame. Can be set to continuous. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Window.)

fields.title: Formant
fields.text: Formant — Adjusts pitch of the wavetable frame, independently from the pitch of the window. Range: -60 .. 60 semitones. (Parameter of Window.)

fields.title: Window
fields.text: Window — Chooses the waveform used for the amplitude window. Range: Triangle, Cosine, Blend 1, Blend 2, Blend 3, Sawtooth, Sine, Square, Rectangle. (Parameter of Window.)
fields.range: Triangle, Cosine, Blend 1, Blend 2, Blend 3, Sawtooth, Sine, Square, Rectangle

fields.title: Low Cut
fields.text: Low Cut — Cutoff frequency of built-in highpass filter. Must be activated in context menu. Range: 13.75 .. 25087.71 Hz. (Parameter of Window.)

fields.title: High Cut
fields.text: High Cut — Cutoff frequency of built-in lowpass filter. Must be activated in context menu. Range: 13.75 .. 25087.71 Hz. (Parameter of Window.)

fields.title: Unison Detune
fields.text: Unison Detune — Detuning of unison oscillators. Can be extended. Can be switched between relative (default) and absolute. Range: 0 .. 100 cents 0 .. 1200 cents 0 .. 16 Hz 0 .. 192 Hz. (Parameter of Window.)

fields.title: Unison Voices
fields.text: Unison Voices — Number of oscillators used for unison. 1 = disabled. Range: 1 .. 16. (Parameter of Window.)

fields.title: Shape
fields.text: Shape — Various variants of sine wave achieved through quadrant masking, shifting and frequency doubling. Range: 1 .. 28. (Parameter of Sine.)

fields.title: Feedback
fields.text: Feedback — FM feedback amount. Can be extended. Can be set to Vintage FM (smoother feedback). Range: -100 .. 100 % -400 .. 400 %. (Parameter of Sine.)

fields.title: FM Behavior
fields.text: FM Behavior — Chooses whether FM behaves like Surge 1.6.1.1 and earlier, or consistent with FM2/3 oscillators. Range: Legacy (before v1.6.2),. (Parameter of Sine.)

fields.title: Low Cut
fields.text: Low Cut — Cutoff frequency of built-in highpass filter. Must be activated in context menu. Range: 13.75 .. 25087.71 Hz. (Parameter of Sine.)

fields.title: High Cut
fields.text: High Cut — Cutoff frequency of built-in lowpass filter. Must be activated in context menu. Range: 13.75 .. 25087.71 Hz. (Parameter of Sine.)

fields.title: Unison Detune
fields.text: Unison Detune — Detuning of unison oscillators. Can be extended. Can be switched between relative (default) and absolute. Range: 0 .. 100 cents 0 .. 1200 cents 0 .. 16 Hz 0 .. 192 Hz. (Parameter of Sine.)

fields.title: Unison Voices
fields.text: Unison Voices — Number of oscillators used for unison, 1 = disabled. Range: 1 .. 16. (Parameter of Sine.)

fields.title: M1 Amount
fields.text: M1 Amount — Modulation amount of the first modulator. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of FM2.)

fields.title: M1 Ratio
fields.text: M1 Ratio — Ratio of the first modulator to the carrier. Range: 1 .. 32. (Parameter of FM2.)

fields.title: M2 Amount
fields.text: M2 Amount — Modulation amount of the second modulator. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of FM2.)

fields.title: M2 Ratio
fields.text: M2 Ratio — Ratio of the second modulator to the carrier. Range: 1 .. 32. (Parameter of FM2.)

fields.title: M1/2 Offset
fields.text: M1/2 Offset — Absolute detuning of the modulators Can be extended. Range: -10 .. 10 Hz -1000 .. 1000 Hz. (Parameter of FM2.)

fields.title: M1/2 Phase
fields.text: M1/2 Phase — Changes the initial phase of the modulators to give different variations of the waveform. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of FM2.)

fields.title: Feedback
fields.text: Feedback — Modulation amount of the carrier to itself Extended mode (default) can be disabled. Can be set to Vintage FM (smoother feedback). Range: -400 .. 400 % -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of FM2.)

fields.title: M1 Amount
fields.text: M1 Amount — Modulation amount of the first modulator. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of FM3.)

fields.title: M1 Ratio
fields.text: M1 Ratio — Ratio of the first modulator to the carrier, can either be extended or absolute. Range: 0.0 .. 32.00 1/32.0 .. 32.0 ~ 8 Hz .. 24 kHz. (Parameter of FM3.)

fields.title: M2 Amount
fields.text: M2 Amount — Modulation amount of the second modulator. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of FM3.)

fields.title: M2 Ratio
fields.text: M2 Ratio — Ratio of the second modulator to the carrier, can either be extended or absolute. Range: 0.0 .. 32.00 1/32.0 .. 32.0 ~ 8 Hz .. 24 kHz. (Parameter of FM3.)

fields.title: M3 Amount
fields.text: M3 Amount — Modulation amount of the third modulator. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of FM3.)

fields.title: M3 Frequency
fields.text: M3 Frequency — Frequency of the third modulator. Range: ~ 14 Hz .. 25 kHz 0.5 Hz .. ~25 kHz. (Parameter of FM3.)

fields.title: Feedback
fields.text: Feedback — Modulation amount of the carrier to itself Extended mode (default) can be disabled. Can be set to Vintage FM (smoother feedback). Range: -400 .. 400 % -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of FM3.)

fields.title: Exciter
fields.text: Exciter — Determines mode and waveform used to excite the string. Range: Burst, Constant. (Parameter of String.)

fields.title: Exciter Level
fields.text: Exciter Level — Determines how strongly the string gets excited. Oversampling and interpolation can be configured in its context-menu. Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of String.)

fields.title: String 1 Decay
fields.text: String 1 Decay — Sets the decay time of the first string (amount of delay line feedback). Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of String.)

fields.title: String 2 Decay
fields.text: String 2 Decay — Sets the decay time of the second string (amount of delay line feedback). Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of String.)

fields.title: String 2 Detune
fields.text: String 2 Detune — Adjusts tuning of the second string. Can be extended. Can be switched between relative (default) and absolute. Range: -100 .. 100 cents -1200 .. 1200 cents -16 .. 16 Hz -192 .. 192 Hz. (Parameter of String.)

fields.title: String Balance
fields.text: String Balance — Adjusts mix between the two strings. Range: -100 .. 100%. (Parameter of String.)

fields.title: Stiffness
fields.text: Stiffness — Applies lowpass (left) and highpass (right) filters in the feedback loop. Results in inharmonic timbres at the extremes. The stiffness filter can be configured in its context-menu. Range: -100 .. 100%. (Parameter of String.)

fields.title: Shape
fields.text: Shape — Sets the oscillator waveform. Range: See explanation below. (Parameter of Alias.)

fields.title: Wrap
fields.text: Wrap — Mangles the waveform by amplifying it, then making it wrap around from the other side instead of hard clipping. Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Alias.)

fields.title: Mask
fields.text: Mask — Sets a 8-bit bitmask applied to the waveform. Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Alias.)

fields.title: Threshold
fields.text: Threshold — Adjusts the turning point (ramp), duty cycle (pulse) or wavetable readout offset (others) of the waveform. Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Alias.)

fields.title: Bitcrush
fields.text: Bitcrush — Sets the amount of bitcrushing applied to the waveform. Range: 1.00 .. 8.00 bits. (Parameter of Alias.)

fields.title: Unison Detune
fields.text: Unison Detune — Detuning of unison oscillators. Can be extended. Can be switched between relative (default) and absolute. Range: 0 .. 100 cents 0 .. 1200 cents 0 .. 16 Hz 0 .. 192 Hz. (Parameter of Alias.)

fields.title: Unison Voices
fields.text: Unison Voices — Number of oscillators used for unison, 1 = disabled. Range: 1 .. 16. (Parameter of Alias.)

fields.title: Correlation
fields.text: Correlation — Noise correlation. 0% = white noise, 100% = pulse wave. Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of S&H Noise.)
fields.parent: Technical Reference › Oscillator Algorithms › S&H Noise

fields.title: Width
fields.text: Width — Duty cycle of the oscillator. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of S&H Noise.)
fields.parent: Technical Reference › Oscillator Algorithms › S&H Noise

fields.text: Low Cut — Cutoff frequency of built-in highpass filter. Must be activated in context menu. Range: 13.75 .. 25087.71 Hz. (Parameter of S&H Noise.)
fields.parent: Technical Reference › Oscillator Algorithms › S&H Noise

fields.title: High Cut
fields.text: High Cut — Cutoff frequency of built-in lowpass filter. Must be activated in context menu. Range: 13.75 .. 25087.71 Hz. (Parameter of S&H Noise.)
fields.parent: Technical Reference › Oscillator Algorithms › S&H Noise

fields.title: Sync
fields.text: Sync — Oscillator hard sync. Range: 0 .. 60 semitones. (Parameter of S&H Noise.)
fields.parent: Technical Reference › Oscillator Algorithms › S&H Noise

fields.title: Unison Detune
fields.text: Unison Detune — Detuning of unison oscillators. Can be extended. Can be switched between relative (default) and absolute. Range: 0 .. 100 cents 0 .. 1200 cents 0 .. 16 Hz 0 .. 192 Hz. (Parameter of S&H Noise.)
fields.parent: Technical Reference › Oscillator Algorithms › S&H Noise

fields.title: Unison Voices
fields.text: Unison Voices — Number of oscillators used for unison. 1 = disabled. Range: 1 .. 16. (Parameter of S&H Noise.)
fields.parent: Technical Reference › Oscillator Algorithms › S&H Noise

fields.title: Audio In L/R Channel
fields.text: Audio In L/R Channel — Chooses which external input is used. -100% = left, 0% = both (stereo), 100% = right. Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Audio Input.)
fields.parent: Technical Reference › Oscillator Algorithms › Audio Input

fields.title: Audio In Gain
fields.text: Audio In Gain — External input gain in dB. Range: 48 .. +48 dB. (Parameter of Audio Input.)
fields.parent: Technical Reference › Oscillator Algorithms › Audio Input

fields.title: Scene A L/R Channel1
fields.text: Scene A L/R Channel1 — Chooses which input from Scene A is used. -100% = left, 0% = both (stereo), 100% = right. Range: -100 .. 100%. (Parameter of Audio Input.)
fields.parent: Technical Reference › Oscillator Algorithms › Audio Input

fields.title: Scene A Gain1
fields.text: Scene A Gain1 — Scene A input gain in dB. Range: 48 .. +48 dB. (Parameter of Audio Input.)
fields.parent: Technical Reference › Oscillator Algorithms › Audio Input

fields.title: Audio In Scene A Mix1
fields.text: Audio In Scene A Mix1 — Blend control between the external audio-in signal and the output of Scene A. Range: -100 .. +100%. (Parameter of Audio Input.)
fields.parent: Technical Reference › Oscillator Algorithms › Audio Input

fields.title: Low Cut
fields.text: Low Cut — Cutoff frequency of built-in highpass filter. Must be activated in context menu. Range: 13.75 .. 25087.71 Hz. (Parameter of Audio Input.)
fields.parent: Technical Reference › Oscillator Algorithms › Audio Input

fields.title: High Cut
fields.text: High Cut — Cutoff frequency of built-in lowpass filter. Must be activated in context menu. Range: 13.75 .. 25087.71 Hz. (Parameter of Audio Input.)
fields.parent: Technical Reference › Oscillator Algorithms › Audio Input

fields.title: Band 1/2/3 Gain
fields.text: Band 1/2/3 Gain — Band gain, can be disabled. Range: -48 .. +48 dB. (Parameter of EQ.)

fields.title: Band 1/2/3 Freq
fields.text: Band 1/2/3 Freq — Band frequency. Range: 14Hz .. 25kHz. (Parameter of EQ.)

fields.title: Band 1/2/3 Bandwidth
fields.text: Band 1/2/3 Bandwidth — Band bandwidth. Range: 0 .. 5 octaves. (Parameter of EQ.)

fields.title: Output gain
fields.text: Output gain — Gain control. Range: -48 .. +48 dB. (Parameter of EQ.)

fields.title: Mix
fields.text: Mix — Blend control between the dry and the wet signal. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of EQ.)

fields.title: Drive
fields.text: Drive — Controls the amount of generated harmonics. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Exciter.)

fields.title: Tone
fields.text: Tone — Controls the tone balance of the generated harmonics. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Exciter.)

fields.title: Attack
fields.text: Attack — Controls the attack time of the generated harmonics. Range: 5 .. 20 ms. (Parameter of Exciter.)

fields.title: Release
fields.text: Release — Controls the release time of the generated harmonics. Range: 50 .. 200 ms. (Parameter of Exciter.)

fields.title: Mix
fields.text: Mix — Controls the mix of wet and dry signals. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Exciter.)

fields.title: Frequency 1/2/3
fields.text: Frequency 1/2/3 — Frequency of the filter for the the first, second or third band. Can be extended. Range: 60 .. 300 Hz 60 .. 7500 Hz. (Parameter of Resonator.)

fields.title: Resonance 1/2/3
fields.text: Resonance 1/2/3 — Amount of resonance for the first, second or third band. Modulation can be allowed to push the filter into self-oscillation from the right- click menu. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Resonator.)

fields.title: Gain 1/2/3
fields.text: Gain 1/2/3 — First, second or third band gain. Range: -inf .. 0 dB. (Parameter of Resonator.)

fields.title: Mode
fields.text: Mode — Sets the filter type used in the resonator effect. Range: Lowpass, Bandpass, Bandpass+Notch, Highpass. (Parameter of Resonator.)

fields.title: Mix
fields.text: Mix — Controls the mix of wet and dry signals. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Resonator.)

fields.title: Input Gain
fields.text: Input Gain — Controls the input gain coming in the Bass Boost section. Range: -24dB .. 24dB. (Parameter of Bonsai.)

fields.title: (Bass Boost) Amount
fields.text: (Bass Boost) Amount — Controls the amount non-linear bass boosting. Range: -24dB .. 24dB. (Parameter of Bonsai.)

fields.title: (Bass Boost) Distort
fields.text: (Bass Boost) Distort — Controls the amount of distortion applied to the bass bosting. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Bonsai.)

fields.title: (Saturation) Bias Filter
fields.text: (Saturation) Bias Filter — Determines which filter curve and counter-curve to apply pre and post-saturation, respectively. Range: Tilt, Pull Mids. (Parameter of Bonsai.)

fields.title: (Saturation) Type
fields.text: (Saturation) Type — Allows you to select the type of saturation applied. Range: Gentle, Normal, Hard, Harsh. (Parameter of Bonsai.)

fields.title: (Saturation) Amount
fields.text: (Saturation) Amount — Controls the amount of saturation applied. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Bonsai.)

fields.title: (Noise) Sensitivity
fields.text: (Noise) Sensitivity — Controls the threshold from which noise will be introduced after the distorted signal path. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Bonsai.)

fields.title: (Noise) Gain
fields.text: (Noise) Gain — Controls the noise output gain. Range: -24dB .. 24dB. (Parameter of Bonsai.)

fields.title: (Output) Dull
fields.text: (Output) Dull — Applies a bandpass filter on the output to taim the low and high frequencies. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Bonsai.)

fields.title: (Effect input) Level
fields.text: (Effect input) Level — Gain adjustment for the effect input. Range: -96 .. 0 dB. (Parameter of Audio Input.)

fields.title: (Scene A/B input) Channel
fields.text: (Scene A/B input) Channel — Balances between the left and right channels of the scene A/B input. Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Audio Input.)

fields.title: (Scene A/B input) Pan
fields.text: (Scene A/B input) Pan — Pans the resulting scene A/B input left or right. Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Audio Input.)

fields.title: (Scene A/B input) Level
fields.text: (Scene A/B input) Level — Gain adjustment for the scene A/B input. Range: -96 .. 0 dB. (Parameter of Audio Input.)

fields.title: Width
fields.text: Width — Gain scaling of the Side-component of the wet signal. Range: -100 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Audio Input.)

fields.title: Mix
fields.text: Mix — Blend control between the dry and the wet signal. Range: 0 .. 100 %. (Parameter of Audio Input.)

fields.title: (Mid) Low Cut
fields.text: (Mid) Low Cut — Low cut filter for mid component. Must be enabled to be used. Range: 13.75 .. 25087.71 Hz. (Parameter of Mid-Side Tool.)

fields.title: Mid Gain
fields.text: Mid Gain — Output level of mid component. Range: -48 .. 12 dB. (Parameter of Mid-Side Tool.)

fields.title: (Mid) Frequency
fields.text: (Mid) Frequency — Frequency of the mid peak band. Must be enabled (with Gain) to be used. Range: -24 .. 24 dB. (Parameter of Mid-Side Tool.)

fields.title: (Mid) High Cut
fields.text: (Mid) High Cut — Low cut filter for mid component. Must be enabled to be used. Range: 13.75 .. 25087.71 Hz. (Parameter of Mid-Side Tool.)

fields.title: (Side) Low Cut
fields.text: (Side) Low Cut — Low cut filter for side component. Must be enabled to be used. Range: 13.75 .. 25087.71 Hz. (Parameter of Mid-Side Tool.)

fields.title: Side Gain
fields.text: Side Gain — Output level of side component. Range: -48 .. 12 dB. (Parameter of Mid-Side Tool.)

fields.title: (Side) Frequency
fields.text: (Side) Frequency — Frequency of the side peak band. Must be enabled (with Gain) to be used. Range: -24 .. 24 dB. (Parameter of Mid-Side Tool.)

fields.title: (Side) High Cut
fields.text: (Side) High Cut — Low cut filter for side component. Must be enabled to be used. Range: 13.75 .. 25087.71 Hz. (Parameter of Mid-Side Tool.)

fields.title: Balance
fields.text: Balance — Stereo balance (left-right). Range: -100 (Left) .. 100 % (Right). (Parameter of Mid-Side Tool.)
